name: orb_atr_scaled_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: NIFTY's 09:15-09:30 window is the overnight information absorption period; large institutional participants hold back directional orders until the range crystallises. When NIFTY breaks above the range high with expanding volume and ADX-confirmed directionality, the previously-withheld institutional TWAP flow begins executing and creates a sustained 15-25 spot point extension within the next 60-120 seconds. The KEY innovation over standard ORB: targets and stops scale with ATR(14 min at 5s) rather than the ORB range width. On high-volatility NIFTY mornings (wide ATR), the setup warrants wider stops and targets; on quiet days, tighter management avoids giving back small gains. This decouples the entry signal (ORB, about price structure) from trade management (ATR, about current volatility regime).

indicators.name: orb_high_180
indicators.formula: max(high) where time_minutes in [555, 570) on each session day
indicators.purpose: Fixed 09:15-09:30 window = same 15 minutes regardless of bar size. NOT scaled — it's always 15 calendar minutes (180 bars at 5s vs 15 bars at 1-min). The opening range is an event-time construct, not a lookback.

indicators.name: orb_low_180
indicators.formula: min(low) where time_minutes in [555, 570) on each session day
indicators.purpose: Same as orb_high_180 — fixed event-time window.

indicators.name: atr_168
indicators.purpose: 14 min of volatility (168 × 5s = 840s = 14 min). Matches original ATR(14, 1-min) exactly: 14 × 60/5 = 168 bars. This IS the correct 12x scaling because ATR is a TIME-WINDOW construct — we want the same 14 minutes of market data to estimate per-bar volatility at the moment of breakout. ATR_168 ≈ 2-5 NIFTY spot pts per 5s bar; ×0.5 delta gives option pt equivalent for scaling stops/targets.

indicators.name: adx_36
indicators.formula: ADX(36) using Wilder smoothing on spot OHLC
indicators.purpose: 3-min ADX (NOT 14-min scaled). We hold 30-120s, so the direction filter should confirm trend over a lookback comparable to the hold window. Original's 14-min ADX is a context filter; at 5s, a 3-min ADX detects whether the breakout bar itself has directional structure — fast enough to signal regime, slow enough to avoid 5s noise.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumulative sum(close × volume) / sum(volume) from session open, reset each day
indicators.purpose: Cumulative measure — no lookback or scaling needed. VWAP acts as institutional benchmark: breakout above VWAP confirms institutional buyers are absorbing supply at above-average prices, adding conviction to ORB long.

indicators.name: vol_ratio_36
indicators.purpose: 3-min volume SMA (NOT 20-min as in original). At 5s, volume is extremely noisy bar-by-bar; SMA(36) = 3 min is the shortest window that smooths tick-level noise while still being reactive to the breakout surge. Original's SMA(20, 1-min) = 20-min context is too slow for a 30-120s hold — we need to know if THIS breakout bar is above-average, not above the last 20 minutes.

conditions: close > orb_high_180 (ORB breakout above opening range high)
vol_ratio_36 > 1.2 (breakout bar volume above recent average)
close_in_bar_range > 0.70 (bar closed in upper 30% — bullish close, not a wick)
time_minutes in [570, 630] (09:30-10:30 IST entry window only)
buy_ce.confirmation: All 6 conditions must be true simultaneously on the signal bar

conditions: close < orb_low_180 (ORB breakdown below opening range low)
buy_pe.confirmation: All 6 conditions simultaneously on signal bar

exit.stop_rationale: NIFTY ORB breakouts typically 'throwback' 8-12 spot pts to the ORB level before continuing; at delta ~0.5 that is 4-6 option pts. ATR_168 × 0.5 × 2.5 with a 3.0-pt floor achieves this on average: on a typical NIFTY session (ATR ≈ 2.5 spot pts/bar), stop = clip(3.1, 3, 8) ≈ 3-4 pts; on a high-vol day (ATR ≈ 4 pts/bar), stop = clip(5.0, 3, 8) ≈ 5 pts — correctly giving the trade more room when the market is choppier.
exit.target_rationale: NIFTY's first-leg ORB extension covers 15-25 spot pts within 2 minutes of breakout confirmation; at delta 0.5 that is 7-12 option pts. ATR_168 × 0.5 × 5.0 scales to current session volatility: typical day gives clip(6.25, 6, 14) ≈ 6-7 pts; high-vol gives clip(10.0, 6, 14) = 10 pts — maintaining a consistent ~2:1 reward-to-risk across volatility regimes, which is the strategy's core edge.

filters.vix_filter: India VIX 12-28 (wide range — ATR scaling adapts to vol, so VIX filter only blocks extreme dislocations)
filters.time_filter: Entry window 09:30-10:30 IST only; ORB signal degrades rapidly after first hour
filters.volume_filter: vol_ratio_36 > 1.2 (breakout bar must exceed 3-min average volume)
filters.spread_filter: limit orders at bar close — no spread concern

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — ORB is a structural feature of NIFTY open; ATR-scaling is a systematic improvement over fixed-range exits. Requires the opening range to be meaningful (less effective on very news-heavy days where range is artificially wide).

adaptation_notes: 1. ORB window: unchanged at 15 min (09:15-09:30); 15 bars at 1-min becomes 180 bars at 5s — same time, more bars. 2. ATR: 12x scaling IS correct here because ATR is a per-bar-range average and we want the same 14-minute time coverage. ATR(168 × 5s) = ATR(14 × 1-min). 3. ADX: COMPRESSED from 14-min to 3-min (36 bars). Original's 14-min ADX is a slow context filter appropriate for 15-120 min holds; at 30-120s holds, we need ADX to detect directional structure within the last 3 minutes, not the last 14. 4. Volume SMA: COMPRESSED from 20-min to 3-min (36 bars) — same reasoning as ADX; we need to compare breakout volume to very recent norm, not 20-min history. 5. VWAP: unchanged concept (cumulative). 6. Entry window: preserved (09:30-10:30 IST). 7. VIX filter: widened slightly from '12-25' to '12-28' — ATR-scaling already adapts to vol, so VIX filter only blocks extreme tail events. 8. Hold time: compressed from 15-120 min to 30-120s (max 24 bars); ATR-scaled stops/targets remain appropriate.
weaknesses: ATR(168) computed at breakout time may be dominated by the ORB window itself (first 180 bars), so ATR and ORB width could be correlated — the 'decoupling' is partial
NIFTY ORB only generates 2-4 valid breakout signals per day; 6 max_trades_per_day is aspirational, actual frequency likely 2-3
Entry window (09:30-10:30 IST) limits to first 60 minutes; late-session ORB retests (common on rangebound days) are excluded
ADX(36) at 5s is noisy and slow to ramp — may miss fast opening breakouts in the first 3 minutes after 09:30
